statement: Four explicit quadratic pair-discriminants factor into signed centre-distance/radius-sum or radius-difference factors; their signs determine reality of the four conjugate pairs.

answer.text: Four explicit quadratic pair-discriminants factor into signed centre-distance/radius-sum or radius-difference factors; their signs determine reality of the four conjugate pairs.

source.version: Original German journal article (1873), GDZ article scan; PDF page 1 is a digitization cover, original p.613 begins on PDF page 2.

scope: Three ordinary real input circles with strictly ordered positive radii and general centres, excluding mutual tangencies and the collinear-centre/zero-radius/straight-line special loci discussed separately.
notes: These are discriminants of the displayed quadratic branches in their coordinate chart; no global reduced discriminant equation or degree is asserted. The common D^2 factor is an elimination-chart issue in the collinear-centre case.
